notes: The named reference is a base-and-income game - each player owns a base off a shared street, buys units that earn for them, and can run into a neighbour's base to take one - which is Simulation's tycoon loop rather than an Action or Party genre, since the layout job is the plots and the street, not a fight. I took the Tycoon preset but substituted plot-isolated for its plot-shared shape, because the author asked for eight separate player plots rather than one co-op base, and kept all three of its options: gate-progression as the purchasable slots and base locks, social-hub as the street-side shop everyone returns to, and path-circulation as the central road chaining the bases to it, which is also what makes stealing possible. Eight plots is the stated count and the map is sized compact around it. Modded was defined as exaggerated props, special-looking bases and an over-the-top layout, so I treated it as styling and scale-of-detail for the image pass; the admin panel is a script permission with no layout consequence. Bases are open-fronted stands rather than enterable interiors, so no P3, and the whole build stays P0.
